title: Treasury Cash Management Microservice
goals: Provide a flat treasury cash-management domain foundation for bank-account approval, cash-position snapshots, liquidity forecasts, and cash-transfer proposal metadata.
Prepare ERP-grade FI/TRM parity metadata without attaching payment execution, bank-network calls, persistence, Workflow execution, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
non_goals: No live bank connectivity, bank API call, SWIFT/host-to-host transport, or payment execution.
No durable persistence, Postgres/RLS, Workflow execution, accounting ledger mutation, statutory filing, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
No SAP, Oracle, or treasury workstation exhaustive parity claim.

acceptance_criteria.given: a bank account is approved for treasury cash management
acceptance_criteria.when: the treasury cash domain approves the account
acceptance_criteria.then: tenant, legal entity, bank, currency, bank-account master ref, opening-balance evidence, control evidence, target balance, idempotency key, approval timestamp, state, and schema version are present

acceptance_criteria.given: bank statement and exposure-flow evidence exist for an approved bank account
acceptance_criteria.then: opening balance, actual inflow, actual outflow, computed closing balance, statement evidence, exposure-flow ref, position date, and false payment/bank-network/cloud/runtime-audit flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a recorded cash position is available for liquidity planning
acceptance_criteria.then: horizon, forecasted inflow/outflow, minimum liquidity target, projected closing balance, breach flag, shortfall amount, source ref, and evidence ref are deterministic

acceptance_criteria.given: a source account has surplus and a target account has a liquidity need
acceptance_criteria.when: cash transfer proposal metadata is produced
acceptance_criteria.then: source/target accounts, amount, cash-pool ref, approval/proposal evidence, source surplus after transfer, target shortfall before transfer, and false payment/bank-network/cloud flags are present without executing funds movement

acceptance_criteria.given: untrusted identifiers, dates, source refs, evidence refs, or money values enter the treasury domain
acceptance_criteria.then: prefix-only, traversal, whitespace/control, credential-shaped refs, invalid dates, invalid horizons, lowercase currency codes, currency mismatches, same-account transfers, insufficient surplus, and no-need transfers are refused

decision_log.decision: Treasury enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat cash-management domain crate rather than a monolithic ERP/TRM module; SAP FI/TRM and Oracle-like cash management coverage is mapped through Enterprise Suite parity composition while payment rails, bank networks, durable storage, Workflow execution, runtime audit emission, and cloud deployment remain explicit non-claims.
